'''Morellia''' was an astronomical object<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> located within the [[Morellia system/Legends|Morellia system]], a part of the [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> known as the [[Morellian Commonwealth/Legends|Morellian Commonwealth]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Morellian]] [[Morellian Enforcers|lawman]] and [[Scout/Legends|scout]] [[Barosa Warren]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" />

==Behind the scenes==
Morellia was introduced in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Morellia [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial object Morellia, in grid square S-3.<ref name="TEA" />
